main_text.p: ςεως σωίσησι. Id est, Varia ac discrepans jejunij ratio concordiam fidei plurimum commendat.
main_text.head: CAPVT VII.
main_text.p: Non fas esse cuiquam recedere à recepta consuetudine, aut constitutione, aut eam mutare suo arbitratu: servandam autem esse in una eademque particulari Ecclesia uniformitatem. Præsertim si diversitas distractionem aut offensionem pariat.
main_text.head: In Harmonia Synodorum Belgicarum, In Conclusione.
main_text.p: ARTICVLI hi mutari, augeri, & minui, postulante Ecclesiarum utilitate, possunt & debent: NON ERIT tamen privatæ alicujus Ecclesiæ id facere, sed dabunt OMNES operam, ut ILLOS OBSERVENT, donec Synodo aliter constituatur.NVM. I.
main_text.head: Ioannes Calvinus, in Epistola ad Mensonem Poppium, in Lib. Epist. Col. 450.
main_text.p: Optandum quidem esset, ut præter DOMINICVM pauci retineantur dies festi: ————— ut tamen obviam eatur dissidiis, cavendum est, ne quisque PROPRIO ARBITRIO ferias abrogans, æmulationem accendat. Sed qui malum hoc sanatum cupiunt, studeant in eundem consensum fratres suos adducere.II.

page.notes: The Greek opening line is partly unclear; the reading "σωίσησι" is doubtful. The woodcut ornament and large initial A are not transcribed as text. The margin note "NVM. I." is partly damaged and may read differently. The dash line in the Calvinus paragraph is a printed blank.
